business_summary: Cizzle Brands Corporation manufactures health, wellness, and nutrition consumer-packaged goods products in North America. The company produces and retails products through its CWENCH Hydration, Spoken Nutrition, and HappiEats brands. Its CWENCH Hydration is a sugar-free sports hydration drink with electrolytes, offered as a powder mix in individual sachets and larger serving containers, as well as ready-to-drink Tetra Paks, in flavors including Berry Crush, Blue Raspberry, Cherry Lime, Rainbow Swirl, Tropical Flow, Celly Freeze, Pink Lemon Flow, Rocket Berry Blast, and PowerPlay Punch. The company also offers CWENCH Protein, a nutraceutical product. Its Spoken Nutrition products consist of nutritional supplements, and its HappiEats products comprise Sport Pasta and SnakStars Sport Bites. The company also provides contract and toll co-manufacturing and production services for beverages in Tetra Pak format for both its proprietary brands and third-party brands serving Canadian and United States customers. It distributes products to sports and specialty retailers, grocery stores, gas and convenience stores, and sports and fitness venues such as hockey arenas, fitness centers, and training facilities across North America and Europe; and retails products through retail channels, websites, and e-commerce platforms. Cizzle Brands Corporation was formerly known as 1348512 B.C. Ltd. and changed its name to Cizzle Brands Corporation in December 2024. Cizzle Brands Corporation was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Concord, Canada.
business_summary_ko: Cizzle Brands Corporation은 북미 지역에서 건강, 웰니스 및 영양 소비재 제품을 제조합니다. 이 회사는 CWENCH Hydration, Spoken Nutrition 및 HappiEats 브랜드를 통해 제품을 생산 및 소매합니다. CWENCH Hydration은 전해질이 함유된 무설탕 스포츠 수분 공급 음료로, 개별 봉지 및 대형 서빙 용기에 파우더 믹스로 제공될 뿐만 아니라 바로 마실 수 있는 Tetra Paks로 Berry Crush, Blue Raspberry, Cherry Lime, Rainbow Swirl, Tropical Flow, Celly Freeze, Pink Lemon Flow, Rocket Berry Blast 및 PowerPlay Punch 등의 맛이 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 기능성 식품인 CWENCH Protein을 제공합니다. Spoken Nutrition 제품은 영양 보충제로 구성되어 있으며 HappiEats 제품은 Sport Pasta 및 SnakStars Sport Bites로 구성되어 있습니다. 또한 이 회사는 독점 브랜드와 캐나다 및 미국 고객에게 서비스를 제공하는 타사 브랜드 모두를 위해 Tetra Pak 형식의 음료에 대한 계약 및 유료 공동 제조 및 생산 서비스를 제공합니다. 스포츠 및 전문 소매업체, 식료품점, 주유소 및 편의점, 하키 경기장, 피트니스 센터, 트레일 등의 스포츠 및 피트니스 장소에 제품을 유통합니다.
